author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-10-07 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: He has never left me alone.
context_before: Remember: the Spirit of truth is not something which comes from without, but from within. You are told: “I will send the Spirit of truth from my Father who will bring all things to your remembrance.” And when you remember, and share your visions, you may incur the envy of men who – if they are high in office – might put you out of the synagogue or the churches. There are times when death is allowed. The inquisition proved that. Tens of thousands were burned alive because what they had experienced was in conflict with the church fathers. We are warned: “They will kill you. They will do this because they do not know the Father or me. Had they known the Father they would have known me also, for we are one.” God, the Father, became me when he sent me.
context_after: If you really see me, you will not see this mortal body called Neville, but the Ancient of Days, infinite Love personified as man. That is my Father, yet He and I are one.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Spirit Of Truth (1968-10-07).
